verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for an email app, but nothing in the evidence shows Gmail can be self-hosted or that users can run their own mail pipeline. Mail stays on Google's servers. Standard IMAP/POP/SMTP access from third-party clients, API access, and custom-domain business email on Google's hosted Workspace are adjacent features, not self-hosting.

support.subject: As a switcher, I can self-host the email app and keep the mail pipeline under my own control
